bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active
unit=$(systemctl --user is-active gace-public-video-collect-resume-20261114.service || true)
state=$(python3 - <<'PY'
import json
p='/mnt/g/GserverStorage/public_channel_videos/_jobs/thegreatolddaysofnippongv.json'
print(json.load(open(p))['status'])
PY
)
if test "$unit" != active && test "$state" != complete;then echo ARCHIVER_NOT_ACTIVE_OR_COMPLETE;exit 71;fi
sum=$(find /mnt/g/GserverStorage/public_channel_videos/1877875443 -maxdepth 1 -type f \( -name '*.partial' -o -name '*.mp4' -o -name '*.mkv' -o -name '*.webm' \) -printf '%s\n' | awk '{s+=$1} END{printf "%.0f",s}')
test "$sum" -gt 2268069888 || { echo NO_VIDEO_PROGRESS_SINCE_PREVIOUS_READBACK;exit 72; }
echo ARCHIVE_PROGRESS_AFTER_READBACK=PASS
echo ARCHIVE_STATE="$state"
echo VIDEO_TOTAL_BYTES="$sum"
echo RESIDENT_USERBOT=ACTIVE
